query: Scanning the workspace's pinned dependency versions, which single entry uses a pre-release version string instead of a stable semver, and what is that exact pin?
notes: Semantic case: the query names no crate or version, so bm25 has no term overlap with any of the 34 `("crate", "version")` tuple rows; spotting the one pre-release pin requires recognizing the '-rc.' pattern structurally against otherwise plain X.Y.Z strings, not matching vocabulary. The pin sits two thirds through the table, so recency keeps only the last few rows (webpki-roots, h2, tower) and misses it; frequency and llmlingua_style have little to key on since every row shares the same tuple-literal shape. The workspace::manifest module path is on its own force-kept use line, separate from the pin row.
